sum: Presurance Holdings, Inc., an insurance holding company, provides specialty property, and casualty insurance in the United States. The company provides specialty insurance coverage for individuals, businesses, and communities. It offers both specialty commercial products, including commercial property, general liability, liquor liability and commercial automobile and specialty personal product lines. Additionally, it offers homeowners insurance and dwelling fire insurance products to individuals owners of lower value homes in Texas, Illinois and Indiana. The company was formerly known as Conifer Holdings, Inc. and changed its name to Presurance Holdings, Inc. in September 2025. The company was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Troy, Michigan.
ceo: Mr. Brian Joseph Roney B.A., B.S., M.B.A. (President & CEO)
